claim_boundary: Tests a synthetic certainty-to-clarification policy input only; it does not test felt emotion, human development, or human utility.

acceptance.paired_difference: per seed: clarify_rate(certainty=0) minus clarify_rate(certainty=3) across matched fixture cases
acceptance.mean_estimator: arithmetic mean of 20 paired seed differences
acceptance.confidence_interval: mean - 2.093 * sqrt(sample_variance / n), two-sided 95% t interval with n=20 fixed before execution

failure_interpretation: If the pre-registered criterion is not met, report the certainty appraisal hypothesis as unsupported for this synthetic fixture; do not retune thresholds or claim a broader effect.
